summary: Dark cars arrive outside a building; suited men get out and move inside to a modern boardroom, where a meeting begins.

beats.event: Several dark-coloured cars are parked outside a building.
Men in suits get out of the cars and gather near the entrance.
uncertain_details: whether they speak to each other

beats.event: The setting changes from outside the building to an interior corridor.
uncertain_details: whether the interior is the same building

beats.event: The men enter a modern boardroom with a long table.
People seated at the table face each other in alternating close-up shots.
